notes: Wikiquote names Ron's Diner, Ron the owner and Annie the waitress; Wikipedia puts the diner in Alaska. Verbatim: 'This order's to go.' (Clark), 'Gimme another plate of this garbage.' / 'That's my number one special, Rocky!', 'Keep it on the flame Rock, this is just minute steak.' (a trucker), 'I was getting hot dogs', 'I forgot your orange juice', 'favorite seat', Rocky landing on the pinball machine that flashes TILT, Clark paying for the damage, tagline 'The Adventure Continues.' The face 2 caption matches the Fortress still. 'Open all night, daily' and 'Booth service' are layout stock but claim nothing about the plot.

vibe.verdict: Ron's Diner is the perfect venue and Rocky's comeuppance runs right through the menu.
